Third round of compile failures in a row, and Codex A/B silent for all three — so I stopped waiting. Two root causes this time, both mechanical, no design calls involved:

1. **`FileStorage` (`Persistence/AtomicFileWriter.swift`) was never marked `public`**, even though `GameSaveStore`/`SettingsStore`/`StatsLogStore` all default their `storage:` parameter to `FileStorage(rootURL: ...)` in a `public init`. Same bug class the codebase already has a documented fix for on `HapticsService` — just never applied here. 2. **`StatsEvent` didn't conform to `Equatable`**, so `StatsLogFile`'s declared `Equatable` (which multiple tests — mine included — already rely on via `XCTAssertEqual(log, StatsLogFile.default)`) couldn't synthesize. Added `Equatable` to `StatsEvent`'s conformance list; every associated value (`UUID`, `DrawMode`, `Date`, `Bool`, `TimeInterval`, `Int`) is already Equatable-compatible — confirmed via `DrawMode` already round-tripping through `GameState: Equatable` successfully elsewhere.

Also fixed the two Sendable-closure warnings the compiler flagged as "errors under Swift 6 mode" while I was in these files — `SceneLifecycleCoordinator`'s `freezeTimer`/`flushPersistence` and `AtomicFileWriter`'s `PreSwapHook` typealias now require `@Sendable` closures. Checked both call sites (`SceneLifecycleAndCorruptionTests`, `AtomicFileWriterTests`) — neither captures anything non-Sendable, so no ripple effect.

Grepped every `FileStorage(` and `StatsEvent` reference across the tree afterward — no other definition or caller assumes the old (internal / non-Equatable) shape. Nothing here touched project.pbxproj, project.yml, or the app entry point. Same ask as last round: next iteration needs an actual `xcodebuild` run — we're now three rounds deep on "verified by careful reading" and it's time that got confirmed for real.
